integrity: All-size mathematical inequalities proved analytically and finite checks reproduced. General graph-state fidelity formula and known complete-graph/GHZ endpoint credited; priority remains subject to independent literature review.
scientific_limitations: Complete-bipartite graph states only; IID isotropic local depolarization after ideal state preparation; pure-state overlap fidelity, not entanglement robustness or gate-level output fidelity; strict order only for 0<q<1; fixed-noise limit not uniform at endpoints.
title: Strict fidelity ordering and a factor-two star advantage for noisy complete-bipartite graph states
